allow_networks.description: List of networks to allow NTP clients from. Each item has IP and prefix length.

allow_hosts.description: List of specific hosts (by IP or hostname) to allow NTP clients from.

restrict_networks.description: List of networks to restrict (relax default restrictions for).

restrict_hosts.description: List of specific hosts to restrict.

server_mode.description: If true, configure NTP servers and run as NTP server (allowing clients to sync to this host).

ntp_servers.description: List of upstream NTP servers to use (as servers or peers).

local_reference.description: If true, use a local reference clock (e.g., PTP) as time source when no external servers reachable.

stratum_weight.description: Stratum weight to assign to this server (0–15). Higher values increase preference for upstream servers.

makestep_threshold.description: If initial clock offset > this (seconds), allow stepping (non-slew) for up to `makestep_burst_count` updates.

makestep_burst_count.description: Number of steps allowed during initial sync (only if offset > `makestep_threshold`).

logging_destinations.description: Types of data to log (e.g., measurements, statistics, tracking, rawdata).

rtcsync.description: Enable continuous synchronization of the system clock to the RTC (hardware clock).

leapsec_mode.description: How to handle leap seconds: 'slew' (gradual adjustment) or 'step' (immediate adjustment).

slew_limit_ppm.description: Maximum slew rate (parts per million) allowed when correcting clock offset. Higher = faster correction.

keyfile.description: Path to NTP authentication keys file (e.g., '/etc/chrony/chrony.keys'). Leave empty to disable auth.

command_key_index.description: Key index used for authenticating chronyd command-line control (e.g., via `chronyc`).

ntp4_enabled.description: Use NTP version 4 (RFC 5905). Set to false for NTPv3 compatibility (rarely needed).

initstepslew_threshold.description: If initial offset > this (seconds), use `initstepslew` to step the clock on startup (before slewing).

hwtimestamp_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to enable hardware timestamping on (if supported by NIC/kernel).

bclient_enabled.description: If true, enable broadcast/multicast client mode to receive NTP broadcasts (not recommended in secure environments).

broadcast_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) for broadcasting time to clients (only if `broadcast_enabled` is true).

broadcast_enabled.description: Enable broadcast server mode to serve NTP time via broadcast packets.

minpoll_exp.description: Minimum NTP poll interval exponent (2^6 = 64 seconds).

maxpoll_exp.description: Maximum NTP poll interval exponent (2^10 = 1024 seconds).

max_sources.description: Maximum number of sources to use for synchronization (0–8). More = more robust but more overhead.

webserver_enabled.description: Enable built-in web server (for chrony-webui dashboard).

webserver_port.description: Port for the web UI (only if `webserver_enabled` is true).

webserver_keyfile.description: Path to TLS key/cert PEM file for the web UI (if HTTPS required).

enable_tracking_files.description: Enable debug logging to /var/log/chrony/ (for advanced troubleshooting).

comment_local_reference.default: # Use local hardware clock as reference
comment_local_reference.description: Comment header for local reference clock.

comment_ntp4.description: Comment header for NTP version options.

comment_webserver.description: Comment header for web UI config.
